changelog:
### VietLab v1.0.1 - Ban nang cap & on dinh he thong

- Giam sat man hinh real-time: Thanh truot phong to/thu nho card (180px - 480px), co dinh ti le chuan 16:9 khong bi gian.
- Tang cuong chat luong anh thumbnail giam sat (480x270 @ 60% quality).
- Tu dong khoi chay cung Windows (Auto-start on boot) va tu dong ket noi lai may chu khi mat mang / khoi dong lai.
- Bao ve go cai dat va tat phan mem: Yeu cau xac thuc mat khau giao vien truoc khi thoat hoac go bo Client tren may hoc sinh.
- Fix lenh cai dat nhanh 1-Click qua PowerShell.
